sources.title: Tucano 2 Cool: Better Open Source LLMs for Portuguese
sources.snippet: Like most large language models trained on web data,Tucano 2should not be considered a turnkey solution for safety-critical or high-stakes applications. Despite extensive data cu- ration and filtering, the model can generate hallucinated content that appears plausible but is factually incorrect.

sources.title: Tucano: Advancing Neural Text Generation for Portuguese
sources.snippet: Via this corpus, we trained a series of decoder-transformers named Tucano. Our models perform equal or superior to other Portuguese and multilingual language models of similar size in several Portuguese benchmarks.
